svg.title: Hamster Express overview
svg.desc: Explore a complete small gameplay loop: control a hamster, pick up cargo, deliver it to a goal, receive a reward and retain progress between sessions. Flow: Move / interact; Carry cargo; Complete delivery; Reward / save progress

g.text: A small delivery game that connects interaction, reward and persistence
Explore a complete small gameplay loop: control a hamster, pick up cargo, deliver it
to a goal, receive a reward and retain progress between sessions.
Engineering overview · purpose, implementation and evidence
